d:
Democrat Mary Peltola defeats Republican Senator Dan Sullivan in Alaska's closely watched Senate race, flipping another GOP seat and giving Democrats a 56–44 majority. The former congresswoman makes history as the first Alaska Native elected to the US Senate, returning to national politics two years after losing her House seat. Her victory also marks Democrats' biggest midterm Senate gains in nearly 70 years.
